cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The capability factory authority, dependency admission, adapter evidence promotion, and notebook user-confirmation boundary were exercised together.
impact: Focused capability factory, dependency, binding, route, and notebook suites passed; execution remains fail-closed when no admitted gateway is configured.
lesson: Keep capability resolution and evidence promotion testable independently from host-specific containment execution.

cause: The current macOS host rejects the sandbox primitive with sandbox_apply Operation not permitted during code execution and native containment canaries.
impact: The local host cannot provide a passing native containment canary, so generated or third-party capability execution remains unavailable and no weaker fallback is admitted.
lesson: Treat host containment rejection as an external gate gap and preserve fail-closed execution until a supported host is available.

cause: A fresh dependency service instance must continue the persisted quarantine-to-validation history before the final scoped admission transition.
impact: Admission transitions now survive service reconstruction while malformed or reordered persisted histories remain rejected before execution.
lesson: Rehydrate durable transition prefixes through the same controller rules before appending a new trusted state.

cause: The former standalone Notebook gateway bootstrap could omit the server-owned dependency admission gate.
impact: Standalone gateway installation is now rejected; the complete CapabilityFactoryRuntime is the only production bootstrap path for execution.
lesson: Do not retain a compatibility setter that can bypass a newly required server-owned execution gate.

cause: The full Python suite exercises the existing code execution sandbox, but this macOS process cannot apply the sandbox primitive.
impact: Full pytest result: 4100 passed, 8 skipped, 1 xfailed, 20 host-containment failures; no weaker execution fallback is enabled.
lesson: Report the full gate as host-limited until a supported native containment environment proves the existing sandbox and experimental profile.

cause: A read-only development-line status probe used a command that is not defined by the formal CLI.
impact: No product or formal-line state was changed; the correct read-only verification path remains verify --line.
lesson: Use only the formal CLI subcommands documented by the development-line control script.

impact: AnalysisLoopSourceResolutionError is now projected as bounded error_details so the Agent can stop and report the evidence gap; no execution admission boundary was changed.

impact: Composable workflow operation schemas and runtime metadata now project from WORKFLOW_STEP_SPEC_CONTRACTS; direct model identities preserve their established API envelopes.
lesson: Use one contract table for composable workflow fields, vocabulary, validation metadata, and registry projection; keep deliberate direct-operation identity collisions explicit.

cause: The real local experimental path was not previously covered by one end-to-end CF4 test.
impact: On the current macOS host, the real Agent-generated Python Adapter path passed through the experimental Seatbelt canary, dependency admission gate, supervisor reservation, contained execution, output read, ArtifactContract completion, and terminal consumption.
lesson: Keep the host-dependent path as an explicit conditional gate: supported hosts must run the real containment test, while unsupported hosts remain a visible skip and never become a fake green result.

cause: The v1.8.3 Agent integration checkpoint required a full repository regression before further release decisions.
impact: Full gate passed: backend 4129 passed with 8 host-related skips and 1 expected failure, golden/invariants 23 passed, frontend 1428 passed, and TypeScript completed successfully.
lesson: Treat full gate output as separate from host-specific containment acceptance; preserve explicit skips and independent experimental Darwin evidence.

cause: The CF3 promotion boundary required evidence from a contained generated adapter and an independent server oracle, not only metadata fixtures.
impact: A real generated Adapter ran under the local experimental Darwin executor; the independent oracle checked the bounded result and ValidationRunner derived E2 evidence with promotion state verified. No approved state or execution authority was created by validation.
lesson: Keep verification derived from an independent oracle and exact contained output; validation must remain execution-closed and approved admission must stay a separate server decision.

cause: Notebook persisted the full content-addressed capability binding while CF4 preflight accepted only the underlying resolver reference.
impact: The server-owned full binding digest is now accepted alongside the legacy resolver reference; arbitrary Agent-supplied digests remain rejected.
lesson: Keep the full Notebook binding digest and the legacy resolver reference as two explicit server-owned ABI forms at the CF4 join.

cause: The local experimental Workbench bootstrap and Notebook route required one real user-confirmed generated-adapter execution proof.
impact: On the current macOS host the full Agent recommendation, user confirmation, Draft, proposal/risk, real generated Adapter, Seatbelt, dependency gate, CF4 receipt, artifact projection, and run-family head path passed.
lesson: Prove the user-visible custom capability path through the actual application boundary, not only isolated gateway tests.

cause: The full repository gate reached the backend regression stage, but the managed macOS host rejected the existing sandbox primitive with sandbox_apply Operation not permitted.
impact: The current run reported 20 failures and 4111 passes in the backend stage, all in the existing code.execute or sandbox containment tests. The new local experimental generated-adapter path has independent passing evidence; no weaker fallback is enabled.
lesson: Keep the full gate host-limited and preserve fail-closed execution until a supported host can prove the existing sandbox primitive.

cause: The new real dependency E2E passed a project identifier where the CF2 BundleAdmission contract requires the scope category project, profile, or global.
impact: The real E2E now preserves scope category and separately retains the project instance in the capability binding; no CF2 admission rule was widened.
lesson: Keep an admission scope category distinct from a project scope reference when wiring dependency execution tests.

cause: The formal rescope CLI rejects legacy broad allowlist entries and also rejects the exact backend app module when replacing an allowlist, so the B0 package could not be added without modifying protected control code.
impact: The deployment authority composition uses the existing B0 AuthenticationVerifier and trust-snapshot contracts from the already allowed Capability Factory layer; no protected development-control or B0 verifier code was bypassed.
lesson: When a formal allowlist replacement rejects legacy broad paths, preserve the frozen scope and compose through existing allowed interfaces rather than editing control machinery.

cause: The prior local Notebook custom-capability E2E replaced the dependency admission service with a hook instead of proving the sealed dependency bundle reaches the Adapter process.
impact: The current macOS E2E now proves controlled fetch, offline wheel assembly, SBOM plus license and vulnerability reports, injected supply-chain verification, scoped admission, sealed read-only dependency mounting, and an Adapter import from that mounted tree before CF4 completion.
lesson: A gateway test must use the real admission service and demonstrate that generated code imports the sealed dependency tree, not merely observe a validator hook.

cause: The application bootstrap previously retained only an authority identifier and could not prove that a deployment supplied a key-backed verifier, current trust snapshot, signed execution-report source, and external supply-chain verifier together.
impact: The deployment bootstrap now requires external authority and supply-chain ports, dynamically binds report verification to a trust snapshot plus freshness state, and installs only a catalog whose verification delegates to that authority. No signer or key is shipped in the product.
lesson: Require the deployment to supply both the external verifier ports and the signed report source before enabling the gateway; make each report verification use a current trust snapshot rather than a bootstrap-time string identity.

cause: The configured in-app browser returned a stale session ownership error for each newly created local tab, so the browser could not control the local Workbench page after one documented recovery attempt.
impact: Browser-level custom capability acceptance is NOT VERIFIED. Frontend component tests, type checking, HTTP route E2E, and real local contained execution remain separate passing evidence.
lesson: Do not promote browser-tool transport failures into product evidence; keep browser acceptance distinct from component and HTTP acceptance.

cause: The managed macOS host again rejected the existing sandbox primitive with sandbox_apply Operation not permitted during the full repository gate.
impact: The backend gate failed only in existing code.execute and sandbox containment tests, while the complete frontend suite passed 169 files and 1430 tests. The new capability-factory targeted tests passed independently; this is not a release pass.
lesson: Keep host-dependent sandbox evidence separate from the application and frontend gates, and do not add a weaker execution fallback to obtain a green full gate.

cause: The complete repository gate was rerun in the host environment after the managed execution sandbox rejected sandbox-exec.
impact: The host gate passed: backend 4135 passed, 8 skipped, 1 xfailed; golden and invariant suite 23 passed; frontend 169 files and 1430 tests passed; TypeScript passed. This resolves the managed-sandbox gate limitation for this host but does not constitute browser acceptance or a release action.
lesson: Record the execution environment with full-gate evidence when native sandbox behavior differs between a managed tool sandbox and the actual host.

cause: A local experimental runtime could previously be installed with no supply-chain verifier, which made its enabled state ambiguous; prior browser acceptance was also unavailable because the browser control session was stale.

evidence.ref: tests/test_capability_factory_runtime.py plus local Notebook browser flow

impact: Bootstrap now fail-closes without a configured verifier. After the Codex restart, a real local browser flow completed recommendation, user confirmation, Draft materialization, Graph validation, and OLS execution with model and HTML report artifacts.
lesson: Treat browser transport state and product acceptance separately, and reject an experimental execution bootstrap that lacks the external scanner boundary it claims to require.

cause: The local experimental profile previously had only an abstract verifier injection point, so a scanner tool could not be rotated, pinned, or invoked through a bounded product protocol.

evidence.ref: tests/test_local_supply_chain_scanner.py plus capability runtime, dependency, and Notebook route tests

impact: A local administrator can now inject one pinned scanner worker. The bridge verifies its executable digest on every scan, binds its license and vulnerability report refs to the exact sealed build, SBOM, and policy, and uses the existing validated then admitted CF2 sequence. No Agent supplies the command or self-approves a result.
lesson: Make scanner replacement an explicit configuration rotation with a fail-closed executable hash check; preserve Workbench as the owner of report binding and admission, rather than embedding a particular scanner vendor in Agent code.

cause: The route container's initial location effect could run after a fast Settings click and close the panel that the click had just opened; this appeared only in the full parallel frontend suite.
impact: The route container now ignores its initial mount pass and still closes Settings only after a real location change. The complete frontend suite passed: 169 files and 1430 tests; TypeScript passed.
lesson: Reset UI state on navigation transitions, not on the initial effect pass, when the state may be opened by an immediate user action.

cause: All v1.8.3 capabilities that are intended for the current local experimental product scope have implementation, integration, and final-host gate evidence. Deployment-owned authority and supply-chain services remain explicit future environment requirements rather than product fallbacks.

evidence.ref: final full gate plus current-host Darwin generated-adapter and Notebook model.custom E2E tests

impact: The local v1.8.3 design scope is complete and ready for release. Production signer/key-provider, deployment scanner attestation, and cross-host containment certification are deliberately deferred because they require trusted external infrastructure or additional hosts; no weak fallback was introduced.
lesson: A local experimental release may close only when its tested boundary is explicit and its deployment-only prerequisites remain fail-closed rather than being simulated with product secrets or weaker execution paths.
